overview: The Medford Historical Commission met remotely to review demolition applications, vote on historical significance, and receive updates on ongoing preservation projects. The commission determined that properties at 226 Main Street and 10 Whittemore Street were not historically significant and voted to lift the demolition delay on 36 Mystic Street.

items.title: 226 Main Street Significance Review
items.summary: The commission accepted the application and voted that 226 Main Street is not historically significant, allowing a proposed five-unit residential project to proceed.

items.title: 10 Whittemore Street Significance Review
items.summary: The commission accepted the application and voted that 10 Whittemore Street is not historically significant, clearing the way for a proposed net-zero housing project.

items.title: 1-3 Vassar Street and 12-14 Wellesley Street Partial Demolitions
items.summary: The commission voted to pass on historical review for partial demolition applications involving dormer additions at 1-3 Vassar Street and 12-14 Wellesley Street.

items.title: Section 106 Review & Site Plan Reviews
items.summary: Commissioners discussed an upcoming Section 106 review for the Medford High School project and agreed to review site plans for 85 Main Street via email.

items.title: Vacant Seats Update
items.summary: The commission discussed the City Council appointment timeline and onboarding process for prospective board members.

items.title: Properties Under Demolition Delay
items.summary: The commission voted to lift the demolition delay for 36 Mystic Street following submittal of revised preservation plans and received an update on relocation efforts for 41 Mystic Street.

items.title: Annual Report Draft & 2026 Goals
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed the draft annual report and outlined strategic goals for 2026, including potential updates to the demolition delay ordinance and district preservation planning.

items.title: Preservation Projects & Archaeological Updates
items.summary: Staff updated the board on archaeological surveys at the Brooks Estate and Thomas Brooks Park, headstone restoration contract bids for Cross Street Cemetery, and survey work at Hastings Heights.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to approve the meeting minutes from February 2026.
